doc: A colour scheme for a house (design/systems.md, Village houses): per part, a colour and how much of it to mix over the type's own, so one palette dresses any type (a player's colour, a village's theme).

fields.name: roof
fields.doc: The roof. Its colour in this palette.

fields.name: roof_mix
fields.doc: How much of it: 0 keeps the type's own colour, 1 is the palette's.
